Waiting Lock.name: Waiting Lock
Waiting Lock.description: The user touches up to five things during a scene, a door, a car wheel, a villain's wrist or a cracked ledge, and sets a lock in each that waits. The first time each one moves, it locks dead and turns the way the user chose: a fleeing car's wheel locks and the car slides to a stop, a punch from the marked wrist stops short of its target, a falling ledge hangs until the people below clear. While any set lock waits the user cannot lock at a glance, and each lock that fires jolts through the user's hands. Strain: severe.
